--- a/rtl/sequence.sv
+++ b/rtl/sequence.sv
@@ -1,44 +1,54 @@
-
 module TopModule(
    input   clk,
    input   rst_n,
-
    output  reg [3:0] gray_out
 );
-//Gray code to binary conversion
-reg  [3:0] bin_out;
+
+reg [3:0] bin_out;
 wire [3:0] gray_wire;
+reg [3:0] bin_add_wire;
+reg count_en;
 
-always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)begin
-   if(rst_n == 1'b0) begin
+// Toggle count enable every cycle
+always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+   if(!rst_n) begin
+      count_en <= 1'b0;
+   end else begin
+      count_en <= ~count_en;
+   end
+end
+
+// Gray to binary conversion
+always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+   if(!rst_n) begin
       bin_out <= 4'b0;
+   end else if (count_en) begin
+      bin_out <= {gray_wire[3], 
+                 gray_wire[2] ^ gray_wire[3], 
+                 gray_wire[1] ^ gray_wire[2] ^ gray_wire[3], 
+                 gray_wire[0] ^ gray_wire[1] ^ gray_wire[2] ^ gray_wire[3]};
    end
-   else begin
-      bin_out[3] = gray_wire[3];
-      bin_out[2] = gray_wire[2]&bin_out[3];
-      bin_out[1] = gray_wire[1]^bin_out[2];
-      bin_out[0] = gray_wire[0]^bin_out[1];
-   end 
 end
-//Binary increment
-reg [3:0] bin_add_wire;
-always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)begin
-   if(rst_n == 1'b0) begin
+
+// Binary increment
+always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+   if(!rst_n) begin
       bin_add_wire <= 4'b0;
-   end
-   else begin
+   end else if (count_en) begin
       bin_add_wire <= bin_out + 1'b1;
    end
 end
-//Binary to gray code conversion
+
+// Binary to gray code conversion
 assign gray_wire = (bin_add_wire >> 1) ^ bin_add_wire;
 
-always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)begin
-   if(rst_n == 1'b0) begin
+// Output register
+always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+   if(!rst_n) begin
       gray_out <= 4'b0;
-   end
-   else begin
+   end else if (count_en) begin
       gray_out <= gray_wire;
    end
 end
+
 endmodule
